security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU enables the Zicfiss extension (advertised in misa or device-tree ISA string, or decoded in TCG) without simultaneously enforcing that the Zaamo extension is also present and active. This could happen through: (1) QEMU command-line allowing -cpu rv64,zicfiss=true,zaamo=false; (2) TCG translation of Zicfiss shadow-stack instructions without Zaamo-guaranteed atomic load/store semantics; (3) misa CSR write accepting a bitmask that sets the Zicfiss bit while clearing Zaamo-dependent bits; (4) ISA string generation that advertises Zicfiss but omits Zaamo.
security_spec.summary: Zicfiss shadow-stack instructions require Zaamo atomic-memory guarantees; enabling Zicfiss without Zaamo in QEMU allows non-atomic TCG translation of shadow-stack ops, causing shadow-stack corruption under multi-hart SMP emulation
